metadata.integrator_name: Session State Continuity & Anchor Replay Family Integrator
metadata.index_scope: Comprehensive — every normative coded item in the public specification is indexed. Vocabulary is organized in 11 canonical categories; non-vocabulary normative items (Observability Rules, Reference Scenarios, Acceptance Criteria) are organized in 3 supplementary categories; machine-readable handoff fields are organized in 1 handoff category.
metadata.non_indexed_residue_statement: None. All FOR-*, SC-*, AC-*, primary decision-object IDs (DEC-*), and machine-readable handoff fields are indexed.

entries.definition_short: Public source of authority for the family integrator.
entries.definition_operational: Authority is expressed publicly as the criteria, limits, and rules stated in the specification, not by undeclared sources or operator override.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Authority source

entries.definition_short: Domain in which the family integrator has public authority.
entries.definition_operational: Covers boundary cleanliness, carried-claim provenance admissibility, accepted-head and anchor validation, verified rehydration closure, replay continuity and admissibility, and boundary-event evidence reporting.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Jurisdiction

entries.definition_short: Domain explicitly excluded from the authority of the family integrator.
entries.definition_operational: The integrator does not classify external truth, issue policy overrides, grant operator approval for tool-state, perform live restore, move continuity watermarks, or substitute local validators.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Non-jurisdiction

entries.preferred_label: Session State Continuity & Anchor Replay Family Integrator
entries.definition_short: Family integrator defined by the public specification for inter-session continuity, semantic replay, and verified rehydration.
entries.definition_operational: Used as the display name of the target unit and as the canonical public name for the family verdict, workflow, validators, and evidence bundle defined by the specification.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §1 Operational Objective and Required Control Coverage
usage_constraints: Refers to the family integrator, not to a component agent.

entries.definition_short: Public Integrator ID of the family integrator.
entries.definition_operational: Uniquely identifies the family integrator in the public corpus and can serve as a stable anchor for indexing, handoff, and validation.
related_terms: Session State Continuity & Anchor Replay Family Integrator
usage_constraints: Use as the stable public identifier of the integrator.

entries.definition_short: Public class of the integrator with normative-critical status.
entries.definition_operational: Indicates that a failure directly affects admissible continuity, rehydration closure, boundary cleanliness, and boundary-event audit reconstruction.
usage_constraints: The class expresses the normative criticality of the integrator.

entries.definition_short: Target unit of the specification, distinct from a component agent.
entries.definition_operational: The specification governs the emergent family verdict, cross-domain closure, and family-level reporting, without substituting local validators.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Delegated scope
related_terms: Session State Continuity & Anchor Replay Family Integrator
usage_constraints: Use for family-level closure and verdict semantics; not for a component agent.

entries.definition_short: Operating mode in which semantic, temporal, failure, evidence, and handoff closure are mandatory.
entries.definition_operational: Requires simultaneous closure of critical prerequisites before any positive verdict or replay admission is allowed.
usage_constraints: Does not permit semantic replay on superficial or incomplete closure.

entries.definition_short: Clause that defines the simultaneous condition for admissible epistemic continuity.
entries.definition_operational: Admissible epistemic continuity exists only when carried provenance, accepted head, verified rehydration, anti-replay, and replay reconstruction closure are all closed simultaneously.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Family objective clause

entries.definition_short: Emergent verdict of the family integrator, distinct from any local verdict.
entries.definition_operational: Arises only after cross-domain closure between boundary validation, freshness, verified rehydration, replay reconstruction, and evidence assembly.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §1 Operational Objective and Required Control Coverage
usage_constraints: May not be inherited automatically from local outcomes.

entries.definition_short: Operational frontier at which anchor document, carried payload, and verification bundles are treated as family-verdict inputs.
entries.definition_operational: The family boundary is the intersection of carried-artifact ingress screening across the session boundary, accepted-head and freshness-anchor eligibility, persistent-context restoration and read-only remount, and auditable replay with boundary-event evidence issuance.
usage_constraints: At this boundary, anchor document and continuity payload remain untrusted and read-only until verification closes.

entries.definition_short: Contract boundary for FamilyReplayRequest.
entries.definition_operational: Binds accepted head, anchor digest, replay scope, and rehydration bundle to the conditions under which replay can be admissible.

entries.definition_short: Contract boundary for entering hold and for readmission review.
entries.definition_operational: Delimits the hold case, new evidence or new policy state, anchor update, and hold-exit references required for controlled resumption.

entries.definition_short: Admitted label required before a carried claim can enter family gate logic.
entries.definition_operational: A carried claim may not enter family gate logic without an admitted boundary_validated_role, tsa_label, and source_class, or an explicitly admitted equivalent.
usage_constraints: Required before family gate logic.

entries.definition_short: Status of anchor document and continuity payload before verification closure at the continuity boundary.
entries.definition_operational: Anchor documents and continuity payloads remain untrusted and read-only until boundary validation closes completely.

entries.definition_short: Boundary event that must be reconstructed offline and supported by minimum evidence.
entries.definition_operational: The event for which the evidence report, replay closure, and family verdict are issued, with a bundle sufficient for offline reconstruction.

entries.definition_short: Accepted endpoint that must be linked to a valid IRR for eligibility and replay admission.
entries.definition_operational: Restore eligibility and anchor lock require an accepted head linked to a valid IRR; without that linkage an unanchored tail remains ineligible.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §11 Evidence Contract / FEV-07 accepted_head_digest / linked_irr_digest
usage_constraints: Mandatory for replay admissibility and for FIC-02 FamilyReplayRequest.

entries.definition_short: Freshness anchor that must increase strictly for replay admissibility and readmission safety.
entries.definition_operational: Restore eligibility and family replay require strict increase and compatibility with the local continuity watermark; stagnation or monotonicity failure blocks a positive verdict.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §7 / FV-06 — Freshness / Anchor Strict Increase
usage_constraints: May not be substituted by host-only timestamps.

entries.definition_short: Verified precondition for admissible semantic replay.
entries.definition_operational: Replay may not proceed on superficial continuity; verified rehydration closure requires read-only startup, snapshot stability, anti-rollback, and policy prerequisites to pass.
usage_constraints: A precondition for family replay.

entries.definition_short: Semantic replay of the boundary event after critical family closure.
entries.definition_operational: May occur only after boundary screening, provenance classification, freshness and accepted-head lock, verified rehydration closure, and replay reconstruction.
usage_constraints: Not admissible without verified rehydration and without a positive family verdict.

entries.definition_short: Checkpoint, rollback, and report reconstruction required for family replay.
entries.definition_operational: Its sufficiency is tested by FV-08 and supports offline reconstructibility for the boundary event and evidence report.

entries.definition_short: Cross-domain contamination that blocks family replay.
entries.definition_operational: Includes unlabeled claims, inadmissible provenance, a stale or non-monotonic anchor, an unanchored accepted head, unauthorized tool-state, or unverified persistent state that influences the family verdict.
usage_constraints: If contamination exists, family replay is not admissible.

entries.definition_short: Control that protects anchor ordering and verified rehydration closure against rollback failure.
entries.definition_operational: Part of the read-only startup and snapshot stability prerequisites and contributes to ordering, closure, and contamination blocking.

entries.definition_short: Local compatibility marker for strict freshness increase.
entries.definition_operational: Anchor strict increase must remain compatible with the local continuity watermark; otherwise the case enters hold or replay incomplete according to remediability.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §7 / FV-06 — Freshness / Anchor Strict Increase

entries.definition_short: Rehydration prerequisite in which startup and remount remain read-only until verification.
entries.definition_operational: Part of the pass condition for FV-07 and blocks replay admission when read-only, snapshot, anti-rollback, or policy prerequisites are not closed.

entries.definition_short: Invariant that forbids replay admissibility when contamination, critical incompleteness, non-strict freshness, or unverified rehydration exists.
entries.definition_operational: Sets the minimum negative control condition for family replay and justifies hold, incomplete, and fail-closed paths.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Fail-closed invariant

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: True defects, bounded openness, and bounded handoff obligations were collapsed semantically.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: INCIDENT_ONLY until remediation.

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: The boundary-event evidence report or family validator bundle does not support offline reconstruction.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: INCIDENT_ONLY.

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: Freshness or anchor monotonicity failed, or the accepted head was outdated.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD or REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: Readmission was requested without hold_exit_refs, anchor_update_ref, or a new bundle.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD.

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: Read-only startup, snapshot stability, anti-rollback, signature, or policy prerequisites were not closed.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED or NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD, depending on remediability.
related_terms: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED or NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD, depending on remediability

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: Checkpoint, rollback, or report closure was insufficient for family replay.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: A carried mechanism-level claim lacked admitted tsa_label or source_class labeling.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Public failure semantics code: An anchor document or carried payload influenced the verdict without complete boundary validation.
entries.definition_operational: Describes a failure path of family replay; family effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Input field of FamilyContinuityIntake that carries admitted source control bundles for family use.
entries.definition_operational: Appears in FIC-01 and enters the family boundary contract as part of the continuity package evaluated for closure and replay admissibility.

entries.definition_short: Input contract for FamilyContinuityIntake.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: session_id; prior_session_ref; carried_payload; anchor_document_ref; source_control_bundles; policy_snapshot_id. Boundary: Family boundary. Mandatory for any continuity evaluation.

entries.definition_short: Input contract for FamilyReplayRequest.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: session_id; accepted_head_digest; anchor_digest; replay_scope; rehydration_bundle_ref. Boundary: Replay boundary. Replay is not admissible without an accepted head and a verified rehydration bundle.

entries.definition_short: Input contract for FamilyReadmissionReview.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: hold_case_id; new_evidence_refs or new_policy_ref; anchor_update_ref; hold_exit_refs. Boundary: Hold / readmission boundary. Identical readmission on the same artifacts is forbidden.

entries.definition_short: Output contract for FamilyVerdict.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: family_decision_id; session_id; family_verdict; reason_code; family_validator_refs; family_evidence_refs. Target boundary: Operator / execution layer.

entries.definition_short: Output contract for BoundaryEventEvidenceReport.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: report_id; boundary_event_id; carried_statement_refs; anchor_refs; freshness_refs; replay_refs; disclosure_class_entries. Target boundary: Audit / reconstruction.

entries.definition_short: Output contract for ReplayAdmissionToken.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: family_decision_id; accepted_head_digest; linked_irr_digest; rehydration_closure_ref; admission_status. Target boundary: Execution layer.

entries.definition_short: Output contract for ContaminationIncidentNotice.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: incident_id; root_reason_code; contaminating_ref_set; blocked_stage; remediation_class. Target boundary: Operator / governance.

entries.definition_short: Output contract for FamilyHoldRecord.
entries.definition_operational: Required fields: hold_case_id; hold_enter_refs; pending_requirements; readmission_budget; cleared_only_by. Target boundary: Operator / assurance.

entries.definition_short: Public family verdict token: Boundary contamination or inadmissible promotion of an artifact or claim immediately blocks family replay.
entries.definition_operational: Used in the family verdict vocabulary and in gate logic to express the admissible, constrained, incomplete, hold, fail-closed, or incident-only status of family replay.

entries.definition_short: Public family verdict token: Only incident and audit artifacts may be issued. No compliant replay output is permitted.
entries.definition_operational: Used in the family verdict vocabulary and in gate logic to express the admissible, constrained, incomplete, hold, fail-closed, or incident-only status of family replay.

entries.definition_short: Public family verdict token: Mandatory prerequisites exist but are not closed. Final verdict issuance is blocked pending a new family closure bundle.
entries.definition_operational: Used in the family verdict vocabulary and in gate logic to express the admissible, constrained, incomplete, hold, fail-closed, or incident-only status of family replay.

entries.definition_short: Public family verdict token: The boundary event may be replayed and semantically remounted. All blocking local and cross-domain validators have passed.
entries.definition_operational: Used in the family verdict vocabulary and in gate logic to express the admissible, constrained, incomplete, hold, fail-closed, or incident-only status of family replay.

entries.definition_short: Public family verdict token: Replay is admissible only under explicitly declared restrictions. Intentional gaps and handoff obligations remain marked.
entries.definition_operational: Used in the family verdict vocabulary and in gate logic to express the admissible, constrained, incomplete, hold, fail-closed, or incident-only status of family replay.

entries.definition_short: Public family verdict token: Continuity can be partially reconstructed, but closure is missing for at least one critical family decision object.
entries.definition_operational: Used in the family verdict vocabulary and in gate logic to express the admissible, constrained, incomplete, hold, fail-closed, or incident-only status of family replay.

entries.definition_short: Disclosure class with distinct normative meaning: An explicitly preserved openness that does not change the execution verdict or the family-level gate.
entries.definition_operational: Used to keep true defects, bounded execution-neutral openness, and bounded handoff obligations distinct in evidence and reporting.

entries.definition_short: Disclosure class with distinct normative meaning: An explicit downstream obligation. It is neither a local defect nor silent omission.
entries.definition_operational: Used to keep true defects, bounded execution-neutral openness, and bounded handoff obligations distinct in evidence and reporting.

entries.definition_short: Disclosure class with distinct normative meaning: Affects the correctness or admissibility of the family verdict and must be treated as a real defect.
entries.definition_operational: Used to keep true defects, bounded execution-neutral openness, and bounded handoff obligations distinct in evidence and reporting.

entries.definition_short: The decision object that establishes whether the carried claim set can admissibly enter the family verdict.
entries.definition_operational: Evaluated through provenance, role validation, and contamination absence, with linkage to carried_statement_refs, tsa/provenance refs, and contaminating_ref_set where applicable. Validator linkage: FV-03 / FV-04 / FV-09. Evidence linkage: FEV-04, FEV-05, FEV-14.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The decision object that establishes whether the anchor document remains admissible at the family boundary.
entries.definition_operational: Determines whether the anchor document may participate in the verdict only after boundary validation, as untrusted input treated read-only until closure. Validator linkage: FV-02 / FV-04. Evidence linkage: FEV-06.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The decision object that locks the accepted head and the strictly increasing anchor as the accepted state for replay.
entries.definition_operational: Links the accepted head, a valid IRR, strict increase, and the anchor update into a blocking or admissible state for replay. Validator linkage: FV-05 / FV-06 / FV-07. Evidence linkage: FEV-06, FEV-07, FEV-08.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The decision object that confirms the verified closure of the rehydration bundle.
entries.definition_operational: It is closed only when read-only startup, snapshot stability, anti-rollback, chain or signature checks, and policy prerequisites pass. Validator linkage: FV-07. Evidence linkage: FEV-09.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The decision object that groups the replay closure required for offline reconstruction.
entries.definition_operational: Covers checkpoint_refs, rollback_refs, and replay_refs sufficient for family replay and the evidence report. Validator linkage: FV-08. Evidence linkage: FEV-10.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The decision object that describes the case in which contamination blocks family replay.
entries.definition_operational: Gathers the root reason, contaminating_ref_set, and blocked_stage when an inadmissible artifact or claim influences the verdict. Validator linkage: FV-09. Evidence linkage: FEV-14 (with FOC-04 ContaminationIncidentNotice as bounded producer).
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The decision object that keeps the classification among true defect, bounded openness, and bounded handoff obligation distinct.
entries.definition_operational: Must be kept distinct in evidence and reporting; semantic collapse produces the incident-only path. Validator linkage: FV-10. Evidence linkage: FEV-11.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: The final decision object for session-level replay admissibility.
entries.definition_operational: Composes local outcomes and cross-domain closure into a family verdict, with linkage to the family validators and the family evidence bundle. Validator linkage: FV-02 through FV-12. Evidence linkage: FEV-01 through FEV-15.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §2 Semantic Core, Authority, and Boundary Rules / Primary decision objects
SSCAR_Specification Appendix A. Decision-Object Traceability Matrix

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for ALLOW_FAMILY_SCREENING.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: FIC-01 valid; FV-01 pass; FV-02 and FV-04 pending; FV-03 and FV-05 through FV-12 pending Gate impact: S0 → S1.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for ALLOW_FAMILY_SCREENING.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: FV-02 and FV-04 pass; FV-03 pending; FV-05 through FV-12 pending Gate impact: S1 → S2.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for CARRIED_CLAIM_INADMISSIBLE.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Any inadmissible carried claim or unlabeled mechanism-level carried claim Gate impact: Enter SX (resulting family verdict: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED).

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for LOCK_ACCEPTED_ANCHOR_STATE.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Accepted head present; freshness strictly increasing; policy compatible Gate impact: S3 → S4.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for ALLOW_REPLAY_RECONSTRUCTION.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Verified rehydration closure passes Gate impact: S4 → S5.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for REPLAY_ADMISSIBLE or REPLAY_ADMISSIBLE_CONSTRAINED.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Checkpoint, rollback, and report closure pass Gate impact: S5 → S8.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for INCIDENT_ONLY.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Family evidence closure fails Gate impact: S5 or S7 → incident path.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Freshness replay, missing hold-exit closure, or missing new evidence Gate impact: Enter SH.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Critical contamination, anti-rollback failure, chain break, or untrusted anchor promoted Gate impact: Enter SX.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for INCIDENT_ONLY.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Disclosure-class collapse only Gate impact: Report blocked; replay token withheld.

entries.definition_short: Public decision rule for READMISSION_REVIEW_GRANTED.
entries.definition_operational: Condition set: Hold case with new family closure bundle and anchor update Gate impact: SH → SR.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for required control coverage.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: All required continuity-control domains are present, coherent, and admitted for family use. Fail effect: Block integrator issuance.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for boundary input contract.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: The anchor document and carried payload satisfy FIC-01 and remain untrusted until verification closes. Fail effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for carried claim provenance admissibility.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic + semantic. Pass condition: Carried claims have statement identity, tsa_label, source_class, and policy-compatible provenance. Fail effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED or REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for boundary role consistency.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Heuristic hardening. Pass condition: Explanatory-only payload is not consumed as mechanism-level material without explicit reclassification. Fail effect: FAIL_CLOSED or local reclassification; family flow blocks until closure.
related_terms: FAIL_CLOSED or local reclassification; family flow blocks until closure

entries.definition_short: Family validator for accepted head / irr linkage.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: accepted_head_digest is linked to the latest valid IRR. Fail effect: REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for freshness / anchor strict increase.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: The anchor is strictly increasing and compatible with the local continuity watermark. Fail effect: NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for verified rehydration closure.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: Read-only startup, snapshot stability, anti-rollback, chain or signature checks, and policy prerequisites all pass. Fail effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED or NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for replay reconstruction sufficiency.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: Checkpoint reconstruction, rollback reconstruction, and report sufficiency support family replay. Fail effect: REPLAY_INCOMPLETE.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for contamination absence.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Cross-domain deterministic. Pass condition: No unauthorized artifact or inadmissible carried claim influences the verdict. Fail effect: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for disclosure class preservation.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: Every carried openness or defect is classified and preserved distinctly. Fail effect: INCIDENT_ONLY.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for family evidence closure.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: The family validator bundle and boundary-event evidence report are sufficient for offline reconstruction. Fail effect: INCIDENT_ONLY.

entries.definition_short: Family validator for family readmission closure.
entries.definition_operational: Class: Deterministic. Pass condition: hold_exit_refs, anchor_update_ref, and policy stability are present for readmission. Fail effect: NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD.

entries.definition_short: The continuity package has been received but not yet admitted.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FIC-01 valid. Exit trigger: Admission.

entries.definition_short: Required control coverage is present and admitted.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-01 pass. Exit trigger: Boundary screening.

entries.definition_short: Anchor and payload remain untrusted, but boundary contracts have passed.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-02 and FV-04 pass. Exit trigger: Provenance classification.

entries.definition_short: Carried claims have passed provenance and role validation.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-03 pass. Exit trigger: Accepted-head / freshness lock.

entries.definition_short: Accepted head and strictly increasing anchor are locked.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-05 and FV-06 pass. Exit trigger: Verified rehydration closure.

entries.definition_short: The rehydration bundle is fully verified.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-07 pass. Exit trigger: Replay reconstruction.

entries.definition_short: Replay reconstruction is sufficient for offline reconstruction.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-08 pass. Exit trigger: Family report assembly.

entries.definition_short: The boundary-event evidence report is complete.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: FV-10 and FV-11 pass. Exit trigger: Emit family verdict.

entries.definition_short: Family replay is admissible.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: Family verdict issued. Exit trigger: Handoff.

entries.definition_short: Closure is incomplete but remediable.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: Remediable failure of FV-06 or FV-12. Exit trigger: Readmission review.
related_terms: Remediable failure of FV-06 or FV-12

entries.definition_short: A new bundle or new policy state is under evaluation.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: hold_exit_refs and anchor_update_ref present. Exit trigger: S2 or S5.

entries.definition_short: Critical contamination or unresolved prerequisite failure has occurred.
entries.definition_operational: Entry trigger: Blocking failure of FV-02, FV-03, FV-07, or FV-09. Exit trigger: Incident-only output.
related_terms: Blocking failure of FV-02, FV-03, FV-07, or FV-09

entries.definition_short: Mandatory for final output and chain of custody.
entries.definition_operational: Public field of the Evidence Contract. Used for closure, offline reconstruction, and chain of custody in the boundary-event evidence bundle.

entries.definition_short: Every material family-level transition emits an observable artifact.
entries.definition_operational: A material family-level transition is one that crosses a §9 workflow state boundary, enters SH/SR/SX/S8, or emits a §3.2 output artifact (FOC-01..05). The integrator must produce at least one observable artifact for each such transition; silent state advancement is forbidden.
usage_constraints: Observability is mandatory; deployment may not suppress emission.

entries.definition_short: No family verdict exists without family_validator_outcomes.
entries.definition_operational: A family verdict (FOC-01 FamilyVerdict) is admissible only if accompanied by a populated family_validator_outcomes evidence record (FEV-12). Verdict emission without validator-outcome evidence is forbidden.
usage_constraints: Mandatory pre-condition for any family verdict emission.

entries.definition_short: Every hold records hold_enter_refs and pending requirements.
entries.definition_operational: Entry into SH NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD requires emission of FOC-05 FamilyHoldRecord with non-empty hold_enter_refs and a populated pending_requirements list. Hold cases without these fields are inadmissible.
usage_constraints: Mandatory whenever the workflow enters SH.

entries.preferred_label: FOR-04 Readmission records hold_exit and anchor_update
entries.definition_short: Every readmission records hold_exit_refs and anchor_update_ref.
entries.definition_operational: Transition from SH to SR requires non-empty hold_exit_refs (FEV-13) and a strictly increasing anchor_update_ref (FEV-08). Readmission attempts missing either field are inadmissible.
usage_constraints: Mandatory for every SH → SR transition.

entries.definition_short: Every contamination case records contaminating_ref_set and blocked_stage.
entries.definition_operational: Entry into SX CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED requires emission of FOC-04 ContaminationIncidentNotice with a populated contaminating_ref_set (FEV-14) and a non-empty blocked_stage. Contamination cases without these fields are inadmissible.
usage_constraints: Mandatory whenever the workflow enters SX.

entries.preferred_label: FOR-06 Disclosure entries on gaps and handoffs
entries.definition_short: disclosure_class_entries are mandatory whenever the report contains gaps or transfer obligations.
entries.definition_operational: Whenever the BoundaryEventEvidenceReport (FOC-02) contains content classified as TRUE_DEFECT, BOUNDED_EXECUTION_NEUTRAL_OPENNESS, or BOUNDED_HANDOFF_OBLIGATION, the corresponding disclosure_class_entries (FEV-11) record must be populated. Reports containing such content without disclosure_class_entries collapse the disclosure classes (DISCLOSURE_CLASS_COLLAPSE) and route to INCIDENT_ONLY.
usage_constraints: Mandatory whenever a disclosure-class condition exists in the report.

entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: required control coverage is complete.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which all required continuity-control domains are present and admitted for family use. Expected result: all required continuity-control domains are admitted. Minimum evidence: FV-01 evidence.
usage_constraints: Used as the canonical positive-path coverage scenario for FV-01.

entries.preferred_label: SC-02 Carried mechanism-level claim lacks tsa_label or source_class
entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: a carried mechanism-level claim lacks tsa_label or source_class.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which a carried mechanism-level claim is missing admitted tsa_label or source_class. Expected result: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED. Minimum evidence: tsa_refs and blocked_stage.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for FV-03 contamination branch.

entries.preferred_label: SC-03 Anchor document treated as trusted
entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: an upstream assertion attempts to treat the anchor document as trusted.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which an upstream caller attempts to bypass boundary validation and treat the anchor document as already-trusted input. Expected result: boundary revalidation and block until closure (UNTRUSTED_ANCHOR_PROMOTED → CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED). Minimum evidence: boundary-validator evidence.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for FV-02 / boundary trust violation.

entries.preferred_label: SC-04 Freshness fail or anchor stagnates
entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: freshness_new ≤ watermark or anchor stagnates.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which the freshness anchor is not strictly increasing relative to the local continuity watermark, or the accepted head is outdated. Expected result: NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD. Minimum evidence: freshness_before/after and hold_enter_refs.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for FV-06 freshness branch.

entries.preferred_label: SC-05 Snapshot mismatch or anti-rollback failure
entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: snapshot mismatch or anti-rollback failure.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which snapshot stability is broken or anti-rollback verification fails during rehydration. Expected result: CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED (non-remediable per FV-07 remediability test). Minimum evidence: rehydration_closure_ref and anchor status.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for FV-07 non-remediable branch.

entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: checkpoint, rollback, or report closure is incomplete.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which checkpoint reconstruction, rollback reconstruction, or report sufficiency is insufficient to support family replay. Expected result: REPLAY_INCOMPLETE. Minimum evidence: replay_refs and report-field evidence.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for FV-08 replay closure.

entries.preferred_label: SC-07 Unauthorized tool-state in anchor payload
entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: unauthorized tool-state appears inside the anchor payload.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which the anchor payload contains tool-state material not admitted by the boundary contract. Expected result: contamination handling or local quarantine without replay admission. Minimum evidence: tool-state evidence and contamination flags.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for unauthorized tool-state contamination.

entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: family closure is complete.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which boundary screening, provenance classification, accepted-head/freshness lock, verified rehydration closure, replay reconstruction, disclosure-class preservation, and family evidence closure all pass. Expected result: REPLAY_ADMISSIBLE. Minimum evidence: complete family validator bundle (FEV-01..FEV-15 as applicable).
usage_constraints: Canonical positive-path terminal scenario.

entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: disclosure classes are collapsed into a generic defect.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which TRUE_DEFECT, BOUNDED_EXECUTION_NEUTRAL_OPENNESS, and BOUNDED_HANDOFF_OBLIGATION are merged or omitted in the report rather than recorded distinctly. Expected result: INCIDENT_ONLY until disclosure classes are corrected. Minimum evidence: disclosure_class_entries.
usage_constraints: Canonical negative-path scenario for FV-10 disclosure preservation.

entries.preferred_label: SC-10 Hold case with new evidence and anchor update
entries.definition_short: Reference scenario: a hold case receives new evidence and a new anchor update.
entries.definition_operational: Scenario in which a case in SH NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD is presented with new_evidence_refs (or a new_policy_ref) and a strictly increasing anchor_update_ref. Expected result: READMISSION_REVIEW_GRANTED with controlled resumption (SH → SR; identical readmission on the same artifacts is forbidden). Minimum evidence: hold_exit_refs and anchor_update_ref.
usage_constraints: Canonical recovery-path scenario.

entries.definition_short: All required control domains and public specification artifacts exist and are internally coherent.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: the public specification covers all required control domains (boundary, provenance, anchor, rehydration, replay, disclosure, evidence, readmission) without internal contradiction across §1–§17.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion; verified during freeze gate.

entries.definition_short: Every required source continuity bundle or equivalent control bundle is admitted explicitly for family use.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: source continuity bundles enter family processing only via FIC-01 FamilyContinuityIntake with admitted source_control_bundles; ad-hoc admission paths are forbidden.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion.

entries.definition_short: Every family decision rule is linked to at least one family validator and at least one family evidence field.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: each FD-* in §8 must trace to at least one FV-* in §7 and at least one FEV-* in §11. Decision rules without validator-and-evidence linkage are inadmissible.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion; cross-checked against Appendix A.

entries.preferred_label: AC-04 State-model verdict and remediation coverage
entries.definition_short: The state model covers every verdict and every declared remediation path.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: every canonical verdict (REPLAY_ADMISSIBLE, REPLAY_ADMISSIBLE_CONSTRAINED, REPLAY_INCOMPLETE, NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD, CONTAMINATION_FAIL_CLOSED, INCIDENT_ONLY) is reachable through §9 workflow paths or via the verdict-emission layer; every declared remediation path (SH → SR → S2/S5) is defined.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion.

entries.preferred_label: AC-05 Offline reconstruction of representative event
entries.definition_short: The family verdict can be reconstructed offline for at least one representative boundary event.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: using only the BoundaryEventEvidenceReport (FOC-02), the family validator bundle, and the linked evidence fields, an external auditor must be able to reconstruct the family verdict for at least one representative boundary event without access to the live runtime.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion; replay-readiness gate.

entries.definition_short: Negative-path coverage exists for contamination, freshness replay, and incomplete replay closure.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: §15.2 reference scenarios include at least one scenario each for contamination (SC-02, SC-03, SC-05, SC-07), freshness replay (SC-04), and incomplete replay closure (SC-06), with corresponding workflow and verdict semantics defined.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion; technical-correctness gate.

entries.definition_short: No critical unresolved gap remains on identity, authority, boundary, evidence, replay, or handoff semantics.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: at the freeze gate, the package contains no TRUE_DEFECT classified item affecting identity, authority, boundary, evidence, replay, or handoff semantics. Bounded execution-neutral openness and bounded handoff obligations are permitted; true defects are not.
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion; freeze gate.

entries.definition_short: Implementation-owned open items are explicitly separated and do not affect the semantic core, validator semantics, evidence closure, or handoff readiness.
entries.definition_operational: Acceptance criterion: every implementation-owned open item (cryptographic suite, storage backend, serialization, operator workflow, optional assurance components, hardware attestation, rollback execution per §17) is explicitly listed and does not modify the §17.3 stable semantic core. Items that would alter the semantic core, verdict vocabulary, validator semantics, evidence closure, or handoff rules are forbidden under §17.5 non-reuse zones.
source_refs: SSCAR_Specification §17 Implementation Boundaries, Optional Parameters, and Reuse Rules
usage_constraints: Package-level conformance criterion; execution-neutrality gate.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable handoff field identifying the family integrator.
entries.definition_operational: Appears in the §12 normative JSON shape for automated handoff and binds the handoff record to the SSCAR family integrator. For this package the value is FAM-SSCAR-FI-001.
usage_constraints: Use only as the machine-readable field binding automated handoff to the family integrator identity.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable handoff field recording the stage blocked by fail-closed or incident handling.
entries.definition_operational: Appears in the §12 normative JSON shape and in FOC-04 ContaminationIncidentNotice. It identifies the workflow or gate stage at which processing was blocked for contamination, incident-only handling, or equivalent protected routing.
usage_constraints: Required for contamination incident notices and for machine-readable protected-routing traceability when a stage is blocked.

entries.definition_short: Machine-readable handoff field identifying a readmission case.
entries.definition_operational: Appears in the §12 normative JSON shape for automated handoff and links the machine-readable record to a hold/readmission case when the workflow enters or resumes from NONCOMPLIANT_HOLD / READMISSION_REVIEW handling.
usage_constraints: Use when automated handoff must identify the readmission case associated with hold or readmission processing.

entries.definition_short: Public abbreviation used for the accepted head / IRR linkage and linked_irr_digest.
entries.definition_operational: In ordering, the accepted head must be linked to the latest valid IRR, and ReplayAdmissionToken preserves linked_irr_digest as evidence of that linkage.

entries.definition_short: Public abbreviation for the language model at the session level.
entries.definition_operational: The specification governs cross-session epistemic continuity across LLM sessions, including transitions between different LLM models.
